title: Zoomed-Out Combat & World Readability
master_reference_lock: V3.8 + five gameplay master references + M213/M214 high/wide world composition

hierarchy.rule: Selection and gameplay relevance outrank raw marker count; the sea-chart center stays readable.

nameplates.selected_target: always readable inside presentation distance; stronger frame, HP bar and range/state read
nameplates.boss_admiral: persistent high-priority read without making every common enemy equally loud
nameplates.collision_rule: Nameplates and world markers avoid permanent HUD and each other.

rules: Loot marker includes distance only when useful.
Pickup radius and reward values remain unchanged.
Loot collection keeps immediate world-space and HUD confirmation.

minimap.rule: Minimap remains circular/compact and does not become a second full-screen information panel.

platform_parity: Same world, targets, markers and priority semantics on mobile/web/desktop; only responsive size/density budgets may differ.
